name: Fujimura Chika
source:
Hobbies: Piano 
Favorite Food: Bagna Càuda
Least Favorite Food: Moyashi
Favorite Animal: Ferrets
Least Favorite Animal: Lizards
Favorite Motto: Love is not seen with the eyes, but with the heart.

A third year, and the classmate of Ninomiya Makoto and Ipponmatsu Yamato. A kind and reliable upperclassman who is always ready to help her peers with a smile.
